description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio (%) and two distinct metrics: Perplexity and GPU Mem. Ratio (%), while also displaying constant reference values for full cache scenarios. The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio (%), plotted on a linear scale with values ranging from 10 to 100 and tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot utilizes dual y-axes. The left y-axis measures Perplexity on a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis measures the GPU Mem. Ratio (%) on a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100 with tick intervals of 10. The "Perplexity" data, corresponding to the left y-axis, is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers; it begins at its highest point of approximately 4.59 at x=10, declines to 4.30 at x=40, rises slightly to 4.34 at x=60, dips to a low of 4.29 at x=70, and finishes at approximately 4.38 at x=100. A baseline for "Full Cache PPL" is shown as a dashed red line without markers, remaining constant at approximately 4.38 on the left y-axis across the entire x-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" data, corresponding to the right y-axis, is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 40 at x=10, increases gradually to roughly 48 at x=70, rises more sharply to 55 at x=80, spikes significantly to approximately 98 at x=90, and ends at 100 at x=100. Finally, a baseline for "Full Cache GPU Mem." is represented by a dashed blue line without markers, maintaining a constant value of 100 on the right y-axis across the entire chart.
